exchanges: ugh leo is on the sofa with his foot up again moaning
Oh no, what happened to him?
five a side on sunday, went in for a tackle and did his ankle, its swollen like a balloon
Ouch, that sounds painful. Has he had it looked at?
ya went to a&e, its a sprain not broken. he's milking it tho
Ha, it still hurts, but the milking is a classic housemate move.
he wants us to bring him snacks all day lol
Maybe set up a snack station within reach and call it even.
good idea. siobhan said shes not his servant lol
Ha, fair enough. Is she the no-nonsense one in the house?
very. shes a locksmith so shes used to people calling her in a panic at 3am, nothing phases her
That's a job that would toughen anyone up. Handy to live with too.
so handy, i locked myself out twice last year
Ha, that's the perfect person to live with, then.
lol yep. the landlord mr achterberg came by to look at the gutters
Are they overflowing again?
yeah all the leaves. his son leo was with him, same name as our leo which was weird
Two Leos in one room, that must have been confusing.
it was lol. the son looked rough, he said hes just getting over glandular fever, was off uni for like two months
That one really knocks people out. Hopefully he's on the mend now.
seems ok now just tired
That fatigue can hang around for a while.
mrs gupta next door caught me in the street, her daughters getting married in Jaipur next spring and the whole street is invited lol
Wow, a big celebration. Are you thinking of going?
i would love to but thats a lot of money for flights
It is, but it could be a once-in-a-lifetime experience.
true. her daughter is an architect in london, she designed some building near the river
That's impressive. Mrs Gupta must be very proud.
she brings it up constantly lol
Fair enough, I would too.
went into bogdans hardware shop for a new mop, he was playing records behind the counter, hes got this massive vinyl collection, like thousands
A hardware shop with a soundtrack, that's great. Bet he has some rare ones.
he showed me some polish jazz from the 60s, it was cool
That sounds like a real treasure trove.
i might go back and browse
Worth it, collectors usually love to share.
ok correction, mrs gupta texted the street group, the wedding is in Udaipur not Jaipur, i misheard her, its at some palace hotel by a lake
That sounds stunning. A lakeside palace is quite a setting.
the pics she sent look unreal
I bet. That might tip the balance on those flights.
dont tempt me lol
Ha, just saying.
leo has now asked for a hot water bottle
Hot? For an injury like that, ice is usually the better bet early on.
thats what i told him, he doesnt listen
Housemates rarely do.
siobhan is off to Lisbon for the weekend with her girlfriend so its just me and the invalid
A peaceful-ish weekend then, apart from the snack requests.
pray for me
Ha, you'll survive. Maybe stock up on snacks now.
already did, crisps for days
Smart move, you're prepared.

the gupta wedding is in udaipur isnt it
has bogdan had anything wrong with him health wise
